common.institution: Faculty of Agriculture — Ain Shams University

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your university email or seat number.
login.firstTime: First time here, or no password yet? Choose “Email code”.

code.intro: First sign-in: we email a 6-digit code to your university address, then you set a password.
code.sent: If this email belongs to an account without a password yet, or to a student record the faculty registered, we sent it a code valid for 10 minutes.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your university email and we will send you a reset code.
forgot.sent: If the email is registered, we sent it a code valid for 10 minutes.
forgot.done: Password changed and every session signed out. Sign in with your new password.

setPassword.introFirst: This is your first sign-in. Set a password to use with your email or seat number from now on.
setPassword.introForced: You must replace the temporary password before continuing.
setPassword.policy: At least 10 characters, not containing your email or seat number.

signup.title: Create your student account
signup.intro: Enter your details exactly as on your university records. We first confirm your university email with a code.
signup.emailHint: Your university address. Other email providers are not accepted.
signup.sent: If this address can be used to sign up, we sent it a code valid for 10 minutes. If you already have an account, we emailed you how to sign in instead.

errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. Contact the training administration.
errors.AUTH_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.AUTH_CODE_INVALID: The code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one if needed.
errors.AUTH_SESSION_INVALID: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.PASSWORD_POLICY: The password does not meet the requirements.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS: This email already belongs to another account.
errors.SEAT_NUMBER_ALREADY_EXISTS: This seat number already belongs to another student.
errors.LAST_SUPER_ADMIN: The last active Super Admin cannot be removed.
errors.SELF_ACTION_FORBIDDEN: You cannot do this to your own account.
errors.ROLE_CHANGE_NOT_ALLOWED: A student account cannot change role.
errors.PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTABLE: This permission cannot be granted to this account.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Please try again shortly.

policy.TOO_SHORT: The password is shorter than 10 characters.
policy.TOO_LONG: The password is longer than 128 characters.
policy.CONTAINS_IDENTIFIER: Do not use your email or seat number in the password.
policy.COMMON: This password is too common and easy to guess.
policy.SAME_AS_CURRENT: The new password is the same as the current one.

errors.EMAIL_LOCKED_BY_ACCOUNT: This email is the student's sign-in email and cannot be changed here.
errors.STUDENT_LINKED_TO_ACCOUNT: This record is linked to an account. Unlink it first.
errors.STUDENT_ALREADY_LINKED: This record is already linked to another account.
errors.STUDENT_IN_OTHER_GROUP: Some selected students are in another group. Tick "move" to move them.
errors.GROUP_NAME_EXISTS: A group with this name already exists.
errors.GROUP_ARCHIVED: This group is archived and takes no members.
errors.GROUP_NOT_EMPTY: Remove every member before archiving the group.
errors.FILE_INVALID: The file could not be read. Upload an Excel .xlsx file.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (4 MB at most).
errors.IMPORT_HEADERS_MISSING: Required columns are missing. Use the template.
errors.IMPORT_EMPTY: The spreadsheet has no student rows.
errors.IMPORT_TOO_MANY_ROWS: Too many rows in one file. Split it into smaller files.
errors.IMPORT_NOT_OPEN: This import was already confirmed, discarded or has expired.
errors.IMPORT_NOT_OWNER: Only the person who uploaded the file can confirm it.
errors.IMPORT_PREVIEW_STALE: Student data changed since this preview. Review the updated preview, then confirm again.
errors.IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS: Some rows have errors. Tick the box to skip them, or fix the file.
errors.PROFILE_CHANGE_PENDING: You already have a request waiting for review.
errors.REQUEST_ALREADY_DECIDED: This request has already been decided.
errors.VERIFICATION_PENDING: Your details are already waiting for review.
errors.NAME_TOO_SHORT: Give at least two name parts.
errors.SEAT_NUMBER_INVALID: English letters, digits and hyphens only.
errors.PROGRAM_NOT_CONFIGURED: The training program has not been configured yet.
errors.PROGRAM_EXISTS: A training program is already configured.
errors.SCHEDULE_ENDED: This schedule has ended and can no longer change.
errors.EXCEPTION_EXISTS: That day is already marked as a day off.
errors.VISIT_CANCELLED: This visit is cancelled. Restore it first.
errors.VISIT_ALREADY_HELD: Check-in for this visit has already opened or closed, so this can no longer change.
errors.VISIT_IN_PAST: That date and time have already passed.
errors.DATE_OUTSIDE_PROGRAM: The date is outside the training program.
errors.FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This type of file is not accepted here.
errors.TOO_MANY_FILES: This visit already has the maximum number of documents.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: File storage is not available right now.
errors.GROUP_NOT_FOUND: One of the selected groups no longer exists.
errors.END_BEFORE_START: The end must be after the start.
errors.URL_INVALID: Enter a link that starts with https://
errors.COORDINATES_INCOMPLETE: Enter both latitude and longitude, or neither.
errors.GRACE_AFTER_CLOSE: The on-time period cannot last beyond the closing time.
errors.RANGE_TOO_LONG: Choose a period of at most 100 days.

dashboard.studentNote: Your attendance and remaining permitted absences will appear here once attendance (Phase 4) is live.
dashboard.facultyNote: Attendance and pending-request summaries will appear here as the next phases go live.

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHint: Your language is saved to your account and applies on every device.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your sessions on other devices were signed out.
profile.protectedFieldsNote: Your name and seat number come from the faculty's records. To correct them, send a request below; it is applied after approval.

change.title: Correct my details
change.intro: Change only what is wrong, explain why, and send. Nothing changes until the faculty approves it.
change.pendingNotice: Your correction request is waiting for review. You can send another one once it is decided, or cancel it below.
change.noteHint: For example: "My family name is misspelled". Required.

admin.title: Accounts
admin.createHint: The account is created without a password and its owner receives an invitation email. They sign in the first time with an email code, then set a password.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email or seat number

detail.suspendHint: Suspending signs the account out of every session immediately.
detail.studentRoleFixed: Student accounts never become staff accounts.
detail.permissionsHint: Defaults come from the role. You can grant an extra permission or withhold one for this account.
detail.noGrantsForRole: This role does not take individual permissions.
detail.self: This is your account; you cannot change its status or role.

verification.title: Account verification
verification.intro: Your university email is confirmed, but your details did not match a student record yet. Until the faculty verifies your account, you cannot see academic information.
verification.statePending: Your details are waiting for review by the faculty. You will receive an email when your account is verified.
verification.stateRejected: Your details could not be verified. Correct them and send them again.
verification.stateNone: Send your details so the faculty can verify your account.
verification.submitHint: If your details match a student record exactly, your account is verified immediately.
verification.submitted: Your details were sent for review.

students.title: Students
students.addHint: Creates the student record. The student then signs in the first time with an email code (if you entered their university email) or signs up and is matched to this record.
students.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, seat number or email

fields.reason: Reason (optional, recorded in the audit log)
fields.emailLockedHint: Linked to the student's account: it is their verified sign-in email and cannot be changed here.

detail.pendingChange: The student asked to correct protected details.
detail.accountNone: No account is linked yet. The student can sign in the first time with an email code (if the record has their university email) or sign up.
detail.fullNameOnly: This record has only a full name ({name}). Fill in the name parts to split it.
detail.groupHint: A student belongs to one group at a time; choosing another group moves them.
detail.historyEmpty: Not assigned to any group yet.
detail.deleteHint: Only records without an account can be deleted. The audit log keeps what was deleted, by whom and why.
detail.unlinkHint: Use this only if the account was linked to the wrong record. The account goes back to waiting for verification and is signed out everywhere.
detail.unlinkConfirm: Unlink this account from the record? The student will lose access until verified again.

imports.title: Import students from Excel
imports.step1: Start from the template so the columns are recognized:
imports.step2: One student per row, at most {max} rows. Seat number and name are required.
imports.step3: Upload the file: you will see a preview, and nothing is saved until you confirm it.
imports.summaryLine: {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}, {error} with errors

preview.committed: Imported: {created} added, {updated} updated. Not applied: {skippedUpdates, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}, {skippedInvalid, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} with errors.
preview.notOwner: Only the person who uploaded this file can confirm it.
preview.applyUpdates: Also apply the changes to {count, plural, one {# existing student} other {# existing students}}
preview.applyUpdatesHint: Without this, existing students are left exactly as they are. Blank cells never erase data.
preview.skipInvalid: Skip the {count, plural, one {row} other {# rows}} with errors and import the rest
preview.nothingToImport: Nothing to import: every row is unchanged or has errors.
preview.discardConfirm: Discard this upload? Nothing from it will be imported.

importErrors.SEAT_NUMBER_INVALID: Seat number may contain only English letters, digits and hyphens.
importErrors.NAME_TOO_SHORT: Give the first name and at least one more name part.
importErrors.NAME_PARTS_MISMATCH: The full name does not match the name parts.
importErrors.EMAIL_INVALID: The email address is not valid.
importErrors.EMAIL_NOT_UNIVERSITY: The email is not a university address.
importErrors.PHONE_INVALID: The phone number is not valid.
importErrors.CELL_UNREADABLE: A cell could not be read (date, formula error or decimal number).
importErrors.GROUP_NOT_FOUND: No group with this name. Create it first on the Groups page.
importErrors.GROUP_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: You may not assign groups; leave the group column empty.
importErrors.DUPLICATE_SEAT_IN_FILE: The seat number appears more than once in the file.
importErrors.DUPLICATE_EMAIL_IN_FILE: The email appears more than once in the file.
importErrors.EMAIL_USED_BY_OTHER_STUDENT: This email belongs to another student.
importErrors.EMAIL_USED_BY_STAFF: This email belongs to a staff account.
importErrors.EMAIL_LOCKED_BY_ACCOUNT: The student has an account; their email cannot be changed by import.

detail.noMembers: No students in this group yet.
detail.searchResults: Search results. Students already in another group are moved only if you tick the box below.
detail.ungroupedHint: Students without a group. Search to find others.
detail.move: Move selected students who are in another group
detail.moveHint: A student belongs to one group at a time. Without this, the request is refused if any selected student is in another group.
detail.addedResult: {added} added, {moved} moved from another group, {already} were already members.
detail.archiveHint: Archived groups keep their history but take no members. Only an empty group can be archived.
detail.restoreHint: The group can take members again.

issues.SEAT_ALREADY_LINKED: Seat number already has an account
issues.DETAILS_MISMATCH: Details do not match the record

issueHints.NO_RECORD: No record has this seat number. Create one from the submitted details if the student is genuine, or link the right record below.
issueHints.SEAT_ALREADY_LINKED: Another account already uses the record with this seat number. Check whether this is a second account or a mistake.
issueHints.DETAILS_MISMATCH: A record with this seat number exists, but its email or name differs from what was submitted.
issueHints.EMAIL_ON_OTHER_RECORD: The verified email is recorded on a record with a different seat number.

reviews.reasonHint: Required. The student sees this reason (not your name).

verification.title: Account verification
verification.candidates: Records that could be this student's
verification.candidatesEmpty: No record matches the seat number, email or name.
verification.link: Link the account to this record
verification.linkConfirm: Link this account to the record of {name}? The record's email becomes the account's verified email.
verification.createHint: Creates a student record from the submitted details and links the account. The seat number must be free.

calendar.noGroup: You are not in a training group yet, so no visits are shown. The faculty will assign you to a group.
calendar.loadError: The calendar could not be loaded. Please try again.

groupPicker.none: There are no active groups yet.
groupPicker.selected: {count, plural, =0 {No group selected} one {1 group selected} other {# groups selected}}

visits.title: Visits
visits.editCancelled: This visit is cancelled. Restore it before changing it.
visits.programMissing: The training program has not been configured yet. Visits can be created once the Training Director sets it up.

fields.title: Title
fields.groupsHint: Only students of the selected groups see this visit and are notified.
fields.timingDefaults: Program defaults: check-in opens {opens} min before the start, on time until {grace} min after, closes {closes} min after.
fields.timingFixed: Check-in opens {opens} min before the start, on time until {grace} min after, closes {closes} min after.
fields.reasonHint: Optional. Kept in the visit history.

visits.lockedNote: Check-in for this visit has opened: its date, time, groups and check-in timing can no longer change.

files.hint: Up to 4 MB. Cover photo: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Documents: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint or an image.

schedule.title: Training schedule

program.title: Training program
program.missing: The training program has not been configured yet. The Training Director sets it up.
program.suggestedHint: The form starts from suggested values; change any of them. Every value is stored with the program and can be changed later.
program.planHint: Changing the dates does not move existing schedules or visits.
program.defaultsHint: New defaults apply to visits created from now on. Existing visits keep their own timing until it is changed on the visit.

fields.name: Program name
fields.title: Title
fields.groupsHint: A schedule for every group is the training-wide schedule; only the Training Director can manage it.

schedule.scheduleCreated: Schedule created. {created, plural, =0 {No sessions were added.} one {1 session was added to the calendar.} other {# sessions were added to the calendar.}}
schedule.editHint: Changes apply to sessions that have not started and were not changed on their own.
schedule.endHint: Its sessions that have not started are cancelled with this reason; past sessions stay in the history.
schedule.endConfirm: End this schedule? Its upcoming sessions will be cancelled.
schedule.ended: Schedule ended. {count, plural, =0 {No upcoming sessions were affected.} one {1 upcoming session was cancelled.} other {# upcoming sessions were cancelled.}}

exceptions.title: Days without training
exceptions.hint: A day off cancels that day's scheduled sessions and tells their students. Removing it restores them.
exceptions.added: Day off added. {affected, plural, =0 {No sessions were cancelled} one {1 session was cancelled} other {# sessions were cancelled}}; {notified, plural, =0 {no students were notified} one {1 student was notified} other {# students were notified}}.
exceptions.removeConfirm: Remove this day off? Its sessions will be restored.
